name: Sumavision Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sumavision Technologies Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides video delivery solutions in China and internationally. It offers video processing solutions, including linear distribution, transcoding, VOD over FHC, trans-modulation, IPTV and OTT, and content security; and live and sports solutions, such as live and sports over IP, SDI over IP, studio central management, Suma media center, Suma Marix, quality management, and reliable contribution. The company also provides access network solutions comprising DAA, hospitality, DOCSIS and PON hybrid, and FFTH; and AV over IP solutions.
